summary: Biggar & Upper Clydesdale Museum holds local collections spanning rural life, archaeology and the town's Victorian street scene.
openingHours: Apr–20 Dec: Tue–Sat 10am–5pm, Sun 1pm–5pm. Jan–Mar: Sat 10am–5pm, Sun 1pm–5pm (last entry 4pm).

summary: The only preserved gasworks in Scotland, operating in Biggar from 1839 to 1973 and now cared for as a historic industrial site.
openingHours: 1 Apr–30 Sep: Sat–Sun 1pm–5pm; closed 1 Oct–31 Mar. Last entry 30 minutes before closing.
